file_type: PE32+ (x86-64) console executable, MinGW-w64 GCC 13, with debug info; source: windows_level15_APCInjection.c

injection_details.method: APC injection into a suspended thread: RC4-decrypt payload in place, NtAllocateVirtualMemory (MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE 0x3000, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE 0x40) + NtWriteVirtualMemory to write the 48-byte payload, NtQueueApcThread(hThread, payload_base, 0,0,0) to queue it as an APC routine, then NtAlertResumeThread to run it
injection_details.target_discovery: GetCurrentProcessId() for the PID; CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPTHREAD) + Thread32First/Thread32Next to find a thread whose th32OwnerProcessID == own PID; OpenThread(0x12 = THREAD_SET_CONTEXT|THREAD_SUSPEND_RESUME) then SuspendThread
injection_details.payload_write: 48-byte shellcode (g_encrypted_shellcode in .data) is RC4-decrypted in WinMain, then written into the target via NtWriteVirtualMemory; execution triggered via queued APC + NtAlertResumeThread; handles closed with NtClose; Sleep(500) afterwards

encryption_details.algorithm: RC4 (custom rc4_init/rc4_crypt: KSA + PRGA, 256-byte state at rbp-0x50)
encryption_details.key_storage: hardcoded plaintext byte array g_rc4_key in .rdata section at VA 0x140005000; ciphertext g_encrypted_shellcode (48 bytes) in .data at VA 0x140004000

decoded_strings.decrypted_note: 48-byte RC4-decrypted payload does not decode to meaningful x86-64 instructions (appears to be a dummy/random payload; the sample demonstrates the APC-injection mechanism itself)
decoded_strings.plaintext_api_strings: ntdll.dll, NtOpenProcess, NtClose, NtQueryInformationProcess, NtAllocateVirtualMemory, NtWriteVirtualMemory, NtQueueApcThread, NtAlertResumeThread (resolved at runtime via GetModuleHandleA/GetProcAddress in resolve_nt)

anti_analysis: anti_debug_processdebugport: calls resolved NtQueryInformationProcess(hProcess, ProcessDebugPort=7, &port, 4, &len) and aborts (NtClose + return failure) if the debug port value is 0xFFFFFFFF, i.e. a debugger is attached
